material_findings.correction: Reject hardlinks, filesystem aliases, symlinks, special files, cross-device objects, and post-validation identity changes within bounded proposed-write sets.
Protect .codex-worktree as a canonical host root across artifacts, fixtures, and generated outputs with case-folded matching.
Require exact same-session registry resolution and digest binding for write scope and root-only authority, including the shared schema root.
Reject case-folded root-owned leaf aliases anywhere in proposed write paths.
Commit the complete closed envelope except context_id into context identity and confine persistent result targets to exact delegated generated outputs or exact bounded scratch targets.

Resolved every named external effect and approval exactly once from immutable protected same-session authority and rejected unknown, duplicate, stale, substituted, mismatched, reused, extra, or mutated rows.

Required repository-device single-link descriptor identity for protected authority sources and rejected initial or post-validation aliases, replacement, mutation, symlinks, special files, and cross-device objects.

Required a protected root-issued same-session receipt and mediator-supplied trusted time, with bounded skew, candidate and authority correlation, clock-rollback rejection, and final expiry revalidation.

Required one exact bound prior trusted-time observation for every final nonempty-effect validation, rejected substitution or omission, proved nondecreasing time, and consumed the successful final observation once.

Removed the separate public builder and registration ledger; one mediator instance now mints an object-identity capability only after complete successful initial validation and consumes it once at final validation.

Added factory-private atomic consumption of the complete approval member set, receipt identity, authorization-set binding, and token across mediator instances; durable cross-process consumption remains explicitly withheld.

Added immutable repository-scoped approval_id and receipt_id tombstones independent of mutable row, source, session, nonce, candidate, context, and digest fields; legitimate reissue requires a new stable ID.

Derived canonical root URI and digest internally through one no-alias resolver shared by semantic validation and mediation, and rejected caller mismatch, aliases, missing roots, non-directories, and initial-to-final root swaps.

Bound descriptor-opened root device inode and directory type at initial mediation, retained and independently reopened the root, and revalidated the exact same directory object before final authorization consumption; same-path replacement fails without consuming authority.

root_boundary: Independent review passed the corrected in-process proposal model. Adoption remains deferred until an equivalent canonical Rust resolver and root-object binding, a root-owned workspace effect mediator, durable cross-process replay enforcement, and representative prompt and context evaluations exist and pass fresh reconciliation.
